# New Epics

## Column Headers

Currently the column headers in the application are styled with `white-space: nowrap` and `text-overflow: hidden` this clips the text. We need to allow the text to wrap and be fully visible without being cut off. I would also like the resulting headers to start at the top most resulting line of the resulting wrapping.

Make sure to review all tables in the application to ensure that all column headers are properly displaying all information and that nothing is being clipped or hidden due to styling constraints.
Additionally, verify that the vertical alignment of the header text is consistent and starts at the top of the header cell after wrapping.
Ensure that any CSS changes made to achieve this do not negatively impact the layout or readability of the table content.
Test the changes across different screen sizes and browsers to confirm consistent behavior and appearance.

## Remove PrimeNg

We should no longer be using PrimeNg components so we should not need either the `@primeng/themes` package or the `primeng` package itself.
Ensure that no code in dms-material is referencing these packages and the the @primeng/themes CSS is not being imported by the CSS and then remove the packages.

## Yahoo-Finance2 -> 4.0.4

the yahoo-finance2 package needs to be updated to version 4.0.4. Unlike typical Epics, this will need to be done in one story. Update the package and then update the resulting code and tests accordingly. Ideally, tests should not rely on the specific implementation of the package and should allow us to change packages in the future. If you find, while making this change, that we are depending on an implementation in our tests, refactor the tests to remove that dependency.
